brief.title: The Rime Crown
brief.premise: A disgraced border-warden crosses a frozen march to deliver a thaw-oath to a rival clan before the winter muster, only to find that the clans' beacon-fires have gone dark.
constraints: Magic is rare, and every working shortens the caster's life.

world.name: The Frostmarch
world.description: The Frostmarch is a frozen borderland of rime-glazed forest and stone holds where rival clans keep an uneasy peace under oath and signal fire.

locations.name: Beacon Hold
locations.description: A stone fortress whose signal fire warns the clans of raiders.

locations.name: The Rimewood
locations.description: A forest of frost-glazed pines where rime coats every branch and sound carries for miles.

locations.name: Oath Stone
locations.description: A standing stone where clan oaths are sworn and witnessed.

locations.name: Thaw Lake
locations.description: A frozen lake that cracks open for only a few days each spring.

factions.name: Ironvale Clan
factions.description: A mountain clan that keeps Beacon Hold and trades iron for grain.

factions.name: Rimewood Clan
factions.description: Hunters who live among the frost-glazed pines and watch the northern approaches.

factions.name: Oath Wardens
factions.description: Neutral wardens who witness oaths between clans and punish oath-breakers.

rules.statement: A lit beacon at Beacon Hold must be answered by every clan within a day, under pain of exile.
An oath sworn at the Oath Stone cannot be broken without the oath-breaker losing their clan name.
Magic is rare; each working shortens the caster's life by a year.
Thaw Lake can be crossed on foot only while it is frozen; it is impassable in the spring thaw.

history.name: The Raising of the Beacons
history.description: The clans built Beacon Hold and agreed that its fire would call all clans to arms.

history.name: The First Oath
history.description: Ironvale and Rimewood swore peace at the Oath Stone, witnessed by the first Oath Wardens.

history.name: The Drowning at Thaw Lake
history.description: A war-band crossing Thaw Lake in the spring thaw fell through the cracking ice and drowned.

history.name: The Night of Answered Fires
history.description: Beacon Hold's fire was lit against a raid, and every clan answered within the day.

conflicts.name: The Dark Fires
conflicts.description: The Ironvale Clan blames the Rimewood Clan for the beacon-fires that have gone dark across the march.

conflicts.name: The Oath Challenge
conflicts.description: The Oath Wardens threaten to strip the clan name from whichever clan breaks the thaw-oath.

characters.name: Asa Korl
characters.description: A disgraced Ironvale border-warden, stripped of her post after a failed patrol, who carries the thaw-oath to the Rimewood Clan.
characters.motivation: To restore her name by delivering the thaw-oath.
characters.goal: Reach the Rimewood Clan's camp before the winter muster.
characters.flaw: Pride keeps her from asking for help.
characters.internal_conflict: She doubts the oath is worth the lives it costs.
characters.external_conflict: Ironvale's captains want the oath undelivered.

abilities.name: Frost-tracking
abilities.description: Reads rime on branches to tell how recently anyone passed.

characters.arc: Asa discovers the oath binds her as tightly as it binds the clans.

characters.name: Torvald Ryke
characters.description: An Ironvale captain who keeps Beacon Hold and wants the thaw-oath to fail.
characters.motivation: To keep Ironvale's iron trade free of Rimewood claims.
characters.goal: Keep the thaw-oath from reaching the Rimewood Clan.
characters.internal_conflict: He fears the dark beacon-fires will be blamed on him.

abilities.name: Signal-reading
abilities.description: Reads signal-fire patterns across the march.

characters.arc: Torvald is forced to answer to the Oath Wardens.

characters.name: Sigrun Vale
characters.description: A Rimewood hunter who watches the northern approaches.
characters.motivation: To learn why the beacon-fires went dark.
characters.goal: Track down whoever put the beacon-fires out.
characters.internal_conflict: She wonders whether her own clan is to blame.

abilities.name: Bow-craft
abilities.description: Hits a moving target at long range in poor light.

characters.arc: Sigrun accepts help from the clan she distrusts.

relationships.description: Torvald stripped Asa of her post.
Sigrun guides Asa through the Rimewood.

storyboard.title: The Rime Crown
storyboard.logline: Asa carries the thaw-oath through the Rimewood to the Rimewood Clan before the winter muster.
storyboard.theme: oaths and the price of peace

scenes.title: The Oath
scenes.summary: Asa receives the thaw-oath at the Oath Stone from the Oath Wardens, who warn that breaking it costs the oath-breaker their clan name.
scenes.conflict: Torvald sent word that the oath must not leave Beacon Hold.
scenes.outcome: Asa leaves for the Rimewood carrying the oath.

scenes.title: The Dark Beacon
scenes.summary: Asa stops at Beacon Hold to find the signal fire dark, and Torvald orders her to stay.
scenes.conflict: Torvald wants the oath to fail.

scenes.title: The Rimewood
scenes.summary: In the Rimewood, Sigrun finds Asa by the rime she disturbed and offers to guide her.
scenes.goal: Find the way to the clan camp.

scenes.title: The Ice
scenes.summary: Asa and Sigrun reach Thaw Lake and cross the frozen ice before dawn, because the lake will be impassable once the thaw comes.
scenes.conflict: The ice is already beginning to crack.
scenes.outcome: They reach the far shore as the first meltwater runs.

scenes.title: The Beacon Lit
scenes.summary: Torvald learns Asa has crossed the march and lights the Beacon Hold fire to call the clans against her.
scenes.conflict: A lit beacon must be answered by every clan within a day.
scenes.outcome: The clans answer the beacon within the day.

scenes.title: The Muster
scenes.summary: At the muster, the clans gather to answer the beacon; Asa delivers the thaw-oath before the Oath Wardens, and Torvald must either honour it or lose his clan name.
scenes.goal: Deliver the oath before the muster ends.
scenes.conflict: Torvald demands the oath be set aside.
scenes.outcome: Torvald honours the oath after the raider chief who put out the beacon-fires is dragged in and confesses.

scenes.title: The Thaw Oath
scenes.summary: Ironvale and the Rimewood Clan swear the thaw-oath before the Oath Wardens, and Asa's name is restored.
scenes.conflict: Each clan fears the other will break it first.
scenes.outcome: The clans keep an uneasy peace under oath.

evidence_quotes: the raider chief who put out the beacon-fires is dragged in and confesses
to find the signal fire dark
labels.rationale: A decisive confession from a character no earlier scene introduces.
labels.correction_hint: Resolve the climax through the oath and the Wardens already established.

evidence_summary: The climax is resolved when a raider chief who appears in no earlier scene is dragged in and confesses.
